limits: One owner-without-stack record fails whole-stream gate. All120 reads, nine no-owner states, failures, logs and locks retained; no accepted subset or replacement sampling.
Full-read brackets plus clock uncertainty are used; no sample-index/weight/midpoint timing. Bounds subtract maximum20 inflight frames and use only completion queue_common/queue_final.
Frozen single consumer normal drain<=20; no acquisition issues, drop, counter gaps, reentry path or arm/finish in observation window. queue_samples are only instantaneous witnesses.
Python frames are candidate interrupted boundaries; C/native internals, GIL hold duration, wait duration, time shares and dominant cause remain unknown. No simultaneous CSwitch in this round.
Different human input and historical CPU/wait profiles are observational comparisons; actual-load perturbation still unqualified.
GUI PID4308 and SDK PID7192 are separate. SDK counters are not SDK Python stacks or GUI GIL ownership.
Receipt starts after Python USB read/assembly; delay excludes unknown upstream age and is not physical-action-to-screen latency.
Other same-process owner candidate threads have trace-reported native IDs only, without retained independent lifetime handles; treat their identities as provisional.
Screen recording sparse frames93..102s have no common QPC anchor. Pose telemetry supports only interval draw presence, not uninterrupted correct tracking.
